name: brycewang-stanford/awesome-journal-skills
description: A very large curated journal skill pack collection (3,964 SKILL.md files confirmed via search, for example PNAS, Cell, AER, and QJE packs). The sample skill, pnas-fit, assesses fit for PNAS journal submission. Skills cover journal fit and submission guidance per journal.
install: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/brycewang-stanford/awesome-journal-skills, then /plugin install <pack-name> (for example qje-skills), plus git clone and copy routes (cp -R AER-skills/skills/aer-* ~/.claude/skills/ pattern)
